label: Something changes, in the general sense of CHANGE_2: some thing changes in some characteristic…
paraphrase: Something changes, in the general sense of change: some thing changes in some characteristic, quality or relation, the thoughts of conscious beings included. Floor item F3 (#1007).

disagreement.note: Conditional disagreement (P-OC-1, owner approval 2026-11-05 relayed on #1010): these claims are On Certainty hinge readings that deny that hinges are known truths (§151; Read/Crary, nonsense; Moyal-Sharrock, non-propositional). They bear on this item only through a bridge no source supplies: that this item functions as a hinge. They do not deny the item, and they are not alternatives to it. No separate hinge floor basis is adopted (P-OC-3).

self_evident.note: Floor item F3 (#1007), approved by the owner on the observation basis; the approval plus that basis is the evidence, so no stating text is pinned (owner, 2026-11-05). Closest texts, recorded as supporting justifications: Aquinas, ST I q.2 a.3 (aliqua moveri, sensu constat) and Aristotle, Physics I.2, 185a12-14 (some natural things move, evident by induction). Both state motion, not change in this general sense: identifying motion or Aristotle's μεταβολή with McTaggart's 'change' is a reading step no source states (TruthCore.Alternatives.McTaggart). Recorded rival: McTaggart's 1908 bundle, defeated by consequence against F3 (MCTAGGART-BUNDLE-DEFEATED-BY-CHANGE); his later reply that appearers do not change is compatible with F3 and is not defeated. Parmenides' denial of change (fr. 8) is not recorded as a rival yet: it waits for a pinned witness. Definition-fork audit adds a precise analyst no-general-change complement, without attributing it to Parmenides or changing approval. A checked consequence from both existing source commitments shows the sourced McTaggart1908 bundle is stronger; refuting only that bundle does not exhaust generic no-change accounts. Structural coverage under explicit EM is registered separately.
